SELECT input_table.country, 
       input_table."gdp (in trillions USD)", 
       input_table.region, 
       input_table.official_language, 
       input_table.internet_penetration, 
       input_table.currency, 
       continent_gdp."GDP (in Trillions USD)"
FROM input_table
INNER JOIN continent_gdp ON input_table.region = continent_gdp.Continent
ORDER BY continent_gdp."GDP (in Trillions USD)" DESC;
